\begin{table*}[htbp]
\centering
\caption{End-to-end results on the 2,000-request QQP-derived stream (seed 42) on an RTX 4090 host. Every miss waits for the recorded generation latency of the served model. Decision overhead covers work up to the hit-or-miss commitment and excludes generation and insertion. Headline token saving counts every served hit; correct-only saving counts tokens reused by true hits only.}
\label{tab:end_to_end}
\resizebox{\textwidth}{!}{
\begin{tabular}{lcccccccc}
\toprule
Configuration & Decision overhead ($\downarrow$) & Served-hit ratio ($\uparrow$) & Hit precision ($\uparrow$) & Avg.\ response ($\downarrow$) & p95 response ($\downarrow$) & Speed-up ($\uparrow$) & Token saving ($\uparrow$) & Correct-only saving ($\uparrow$) \\
\midrule
No cache & -- & -- & -- & 2.694 s & 4.46 s & 1.00$\times$ & 0.0\% & 0.0\% \\
C1: Bi-encoder only & \textbf{7.16 ms} & \textbf{53.2\%} & 92.1\% & \textbf{1.219 s} & \textbf{3.60 s} & \textbf{2.21$\times$} & \textbf{55.4\%} & \textbf{51.3\%} \\
C2: Cheap-feature stacking & 10.14 ms & 51.1\% & 94.8\% & 1.272 s & 3.64 s & 2.12$\times$ & 53.2\% & 50.7\% \\
C3: Cross-encoder re-ranking & 18.68 ms & 51.7\% & 94.3\% & 1.269 s & 3.66 s & 2.12$\times$ & 53.9\% & 51.0\% \\
C4: Full stacking & 21.81 ms & 51.3\% & \textbf{95.0\%} & 1.282 s & 3.67 s & 2.10$\times$ & 53.6\% & 51.1\% \\
C5: Gated verification & 10.60 ms & 51.6\% & 94.4\% & 1.263 s & 3.65 s & 2.13$\times$ & 53.9\% & 51.0\% \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
}
\end{table*}

\begin{table*}[htbp]
\centering
\caption{Answer-level audit of served hits (seed 42). An LLM judge reads the user's question, the cached answer and a freshly generated reference answer, and decides whether the cached answer is acceptable. Hits are sampled per label stratum (judged pairs in parentheses); verbatim repeats are counted as acceptable. Judge-based precision reweights the strata to each configuration's label mix. Agreement between judge and labels: 72.8\% (Cohen's $\kappa=0.40$, 228 pairs).}
\label{tab:answer_audit}
\resizebox{\textwidth}{!}{
\begin{tabular}{lcccccc}
\toprule
